test_title: PYST 49: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 21 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the sentence is referring to **China's control over Tibet.**
 
• The term that best describes this action is **"annexation"**, which means the **incorporation of a territory into another geo-political entity.**
 
• **Annexation = '**the action of annexing something, especially territory.'
 
 
• ***The annexation of Bosnia and Herzegovina was acknowledged by the Powers***
 
 

Hence the correct sentence is '....... and 12 years after China’s **annexation**__ of Tibet.'

*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__***

 
• Option 1, "***regression***", refers to a return to a previous or less advanced state which does not fit the context of taking control over a territory.
 
• Option 2, "***relapse***", generally means a return to a worse state after improvement, which is not appropriate here.
 
• Option 4, "***throwback***", suggests a reversion to an earlier time, also not suitable in this context.
